# Nova Rock 2027 reviewed markup fixture

This compact fixture transcribes only the page identity and 44 bounded artist cards (including official caption, artist URL, day, and billing class) from a read-only HTTP 200 fetch of https://www.novarock.at/lineup/ on 2026-10-08. The original 216,722-byte capture remains local at /tmp/novarock-lineup.html; its SHA-256 is cd0ffee8e50b30c67a5f755d0d0bf49930b83f1766adb667b781b5f404af214e. Tracking scripts, media URLs, navigation, and unrelated page markup are deliberately omitted. Synthetic tests add 2026/sidebar/hidden/duplicate decoys, and the adapter was separately probed against the unmodified live capture. The HTML is untrusted data and is never executed.

The official title is “Line-Up 2027”; its canonical/OG URL names the 2027 event ending in 2027-06-09/. The observed 44 cards have 4 explicitly billed headliners and 40 support artists over 2027-06-09 through 2027-06-12 (day counts 8/14/10/12). The official second-wave announcement says the 2027 event again lasts four days; the old first-acts article still says June 10–12, so neither news article is an eligible parser input. The adapter never infers a complete lineup. It fails closed if the page identity, card structure, day, role or the 44-card minimum drifts, and always marks a successfully extracted candidate for agent review.

## Production state and review gate (read-only snapshot, 2026-10-08)

At deployed 952f2a5d0412967c74ce93894c44efcec151e35d the sole enabled Nova Rock 2027 source was cmuaee22i00xy6ncnc5uf6xxk. Its URL was https://www.novarock.at/, strategies json_ld_event + html_fallback, parserKey json_ld_event+html_fallback, direct fetch with no follow-link, daily cadence, no current lease or failures. The bound edition was PARTIAL with 2027-06-10 through 2027-06-12, headliners Die Ärzte and Motionless In White, and support act TBS. No CatalogPlaylistRefresh rows were present. The homepage generic extractors now find no current event JSON-LD and only a tickets URL; this does not update those stale edition facts.

This PR registers only official_markup:nova-rock. It neither switches the source nor updates the catalogue. An independent release reviewer must verify the exact deployed registry, page/current bill, edition/source bindings, active leases, candidates and artist identities before a guarded CAS retarget under existing locks to https://www.novarock.at/lineup/ with official_markup strategy/parserKey and direct fetch; no source mutation is performed here.

Against the production facts, the normal candidate is REVIEW: June 10→9 changes an existing date; Motionless In White moves from headliner to support (headliner removal); every successful candidate also carries a provider-activity review warning. It cannot publish merely by switching the source. The generic publication path currently cannot atomically reclassify an artist across billing roles, and lineup/headliner publications would enqueue a Spotify playlist refresh unless an independently reviewed source-specific deferral is implemented. A separate narrow importer/publication change with explicit evidence, tests, and identity review is required for safe *normal-path* public correction; do not manually edit the production catalogue or strip the warning. Review TBS versus The Butcher Sisters and Slash feat. Myles Kennedy & The Conspirators versus any existing canonical artist before deciding aliases; artist URL slugs are evidence, not approved identity mappings. No provider playlist was queued by this PR.
